title: NRP Advanced Provider Course
seo_title: NRP Advanced Provider Course in Springfield, MO
description: This NRP Advanced Provider course teaches advanced newborn resuscitation skills and leads to AAP/AHA NRP certification. It takes place on December 17, 2026, with the time to be determined, at Cox North Education Center, K400, Classroom #1, 1423 N Jefferson Ave in Springfield, MO. Enter on the Robberson St. side, labeled Northwest Entrance.
